caption: swipe for the week the sky had, jan 10 to jan 16. one of these is about your love life.

slides.headline: what just happened in the *sky* this week?
*mars* stopped and started backing up
slides.body: week one of the redo. if your plans felt sticky, that's the reading. it runs into spring.

slides.headline: *venus* went deep for a night
slides.body: astrologers read it as honesty with weight. if someone said something real on monday, it was real.

slides.headline: *mercury* hit aquarius, then met pluto
slides.body: talk went from cool to blunt in three days. the group chat had opinions. some were true.

slides.headline: uranus and *neptune* made a quiet sextile
slides.body: two of the slowest planets lined up. astrologers read it as a long, background shift, not a news day.

slides.headline: a half moon in *aries* asked for a decision
slides.body: and venus trined saturn the same day. if you committed to something small, good. keep it.

slides.headline: *venus* squared a backwards mars
slides.body: wanting it and getting it were on different clocks. a slow reply this week wasn't a verdict.

slides.headline: the redo is *working*. even if it's slow.
slides.body: save this. aquarius season starts on wednesday.
